title: Tuko Salaad & Adhkaar v3.0.1
changelog: Saxitaanka Cilladda Aadaanka: Aadaanka oo aan marnaba soo dhicin xilli aan xilligiisa ahayn.
Waqtiyada Saxda ah ee Magaalada: Xisaabinta tooska ah ee xilliyada salaadda magaaladaada maalin kasta iyadoon lagu xayirnayn jadwal go'an.
Joojinta Aadaanka Soo Daaha: Haddii app-ka la furo xilli salaaddu dhaaftay, aadaanku mar dambe dib uma soo yeerayo.
Xaqiijinta Android Native Alarm & Push: Qalabka oo kaliya loogu diro salaadaha soo socda ee mustaqbalka.
